# policyctl — LLM-Ready Documentation

> Provider-agnostic policy runtime for coding agents. One `.policyctl.yml`, enforced inside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and CI — at tool-call time and in the diff. Not prompt text.

## Product metadata

- **Product type:** CLI & Developer Tooling + Agent & AI Workflow Engine
- **Version:** v0.1.6 (Stable)
- **Runtime:** Node >= 20, Cloudflare Workers (V8 isolates), Cloudflare D1 (SQLite), KV, R2, Turnstile
- **License:** MIT
- **Source:** https://github.com/RavaniRoshan/policyctl

## Install

```bash
npm install -g @policyctl/cli
# or, no install:
npx @policyctl/cli check
```

## Quick start

```bash
policyctl init --template full              # scaffold .policyctl.yml
policyctl list                              # show your rules
policyctl gen claude                       # wire hooks into .claude/settings.json
policyctl gen codex                         # wire Starlark exec-policy
policyctl gen cursor                        # wire hooks.json
policyctl check                             # run the CI/diff gate against the current diff
```

## How it works

A policy rule has three parts: `when` (matchers), `enforce` (`block` | `fail` | `warn`), and `scope` (`hook` | `ci` | `both`).

- **Hook surface** — `policyctl eval --hook` is called by each agent's pre-tool hook on every tool call. Exits `2` to block, `1` to warn, `0` to allow. Fast and offline.
- **CI surface** — `policyctl check` parses the git diff (including untracked files) and applies the same rules. This is the source of truth for what the agent actually produced.

## Rules reference

| Matcher | Surface | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | hook + ci | Glob over the file the tool touches (hook) or changed files (ci) |
| `command` | hook | Regex over a shell command (e.g. the Bash tool) |
| `tool` | hook | Tool name (exact, or `/regex/`) |
| `diff_contains` | ci | Substring that must be present in the diff |
| `diff_not_contains` | ci | Substring that must be absent (e.g. a generator signature) |
| `diff_regex` | ci | Regex over the full diff text |
| `diff_paths_glob` | ci | Glob that must match ≥1 changed file |
| `diff_paths_not_glob` | ci | Glob that must match no changed file |

All matchers in a rule are ANDed. A `both` rule fires on the matchers relevant to whichever surface is active.

## Example rule

```yaml
rules:
  - id: migrations-via-generator
    description: "DB migrations must come from `make migrate`, never handwritten."
    scope: both
    when:
      path: "db/migrations/**"
      diff_not_contains: "! Generated by make migrate -- do not edit by hand."
    enforce: block
```

## Provider coverage

| Provider | Hook type | Enforcement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Claude Code** | `PreToolUse` hook via `.claude/settings.json` | Exit-2 blocks the tool call before it runs |
| **OpenAI Codex** | Starlark `.rules` via `exec-policy` | Pre-execution allow/prompt/forbidden |
| **Cursor** | `preToolUse` via `.cursor/hooks.json` | Exit-2 blocks with `failClosed` support |
| **CI** (GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc.) | `policyctl check` | Fails the build on blocking rules |

## Phases

| Phase | Scope | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A** | Local-first runtime (engine, generated hooks, CI gate) | Shipped — `@policyctl/cli` + `@policyctl/core` on npm |
| **B** | Hosted control plane (auth, orgs, policy versioning, violation feed, dashboard) | Shipped — Cloudflare Workers + D1 + KV + R2 |
| **C** | Analytics & fleet (analytics API, CSV export, Turnstile on auth) | Shipped |
| **D** | AI + real-time sessions (Workers AI rule authoring, Durable Objects live streaming) | Shipped (core); AI gated behind paid tier |

## Hosted API

The CLI talks to the control plane over REST. Auth is a bearer token saved to `~/.policyctl/config.json`, or a session cookie when using the web dashboard.

### Auth endpoints

| Method & path | Description | Auth |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST /api/auth/signup | Register with email/password + Turnstile | Turnstile |
| POST /api/auth/login | Login with email/password + Turnstile, sets cookie | Turnstile |
| GET /api/auth/oauth/google | Redirect to Google OAuth consent | None |
| GET /api/auth/oauth/callback | Google OAuth callback handler | None |
| POST /api/auth/logout | Clear session cookie | Cookie |
| GET /api/me | Returns current user from session cookie | Cookie |
| POST /api/login | Legacy endpoint for CLI v0.1.6 (email only) | None |

### Policy endpoints

| Method & path | Description |
| --- | --- |
| POST /api/policy | Push policy as a new immutable version |
| GET /api/policy | Fetch the current policy version |
| GET /api/policy/versions | List all policy versions with rollback support |
| POST /api/policy/versions/:id/rollback | Restore a previous version |
| POST /api/report | Send a violation result to the feed |
| GET /api/violations | Read the violation feed (paginated) |

### Analytics & exports (Phase C)

| Method & path | Description |
| --- | --- |
| GET /api/analytics?days=N | Compliance score, active sessions, violations trend |
| GET /api/export/violations.csv | Presigned R2 URL or inline CSV for violation export |

### AI endpoints (Phase D, paid tier)

| Method & path | Description |
| --- | --- |
| POST /api/ai/author | Generate a rule from natural-language description |
| POST /api/ai/analyze | Analyze a diff for risk + suggest policy |

## CLI commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `policyctl init [--template <name>]` | Scaffold `.policyctl.yml` |
| `policyctl list` | List rules and their scope |
| `policyctl check [--from <ref> --to <ref>]` | CI/diff gate (non-zero on violation) |
| `policyctl eval --hook` | Hook evaluator (reads JSON on stdin) |
| `policyctl gen <claude|codex|cursor> [--print]` | Generate provider hook glue |
| `policyctl trace` | Explain which matchers fire for a given input |
| `policyctl test` | Run the policy against a fixture suite |
| `policyctl login / push / pull` | Optional hosted control plane (org policy sync) |
| `policyctl check --report` | CI gate that also reports to the violation feed |

## Pricing

| | Local CLI | Cloud control plane |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Cost** | Free (MIT) | $5 / seat / month (14-day free trial) |
| Enforcement | Full hooks + CI gate | Full hooks + CI gate |
| Policy versioning | No | Immutable versions + rollback |
| Audit dashboard | No | Live violation feed + CSV export |
| Analytics | No | Compliance score, trend, attribution |
| Turnstile on auth | N/A | Yes (Cloudflare Turnstile) |
| Off-line | Yes | CLI works offline; sync when online |

## Architecture

- **Runtime:** Cloudflare Workers (V8 isolates, no cold-start server)
- **Database:** Cloudflare D1 (SQLite at the edge)
- **Cache:** KV namespace for sub-ms policy + session lookups
- **Object storage:** Cloudflare R2 for CSV exports (S3-compatible)
- **Security:** Cloudflare Turnstile on auth endpoints
- **AI:** Workers AI binding for semantic policy intelligence (Phase D, paid tier)
- **Dashboard:** React + Tailwind SPA (`web/`) consuming the Worker API
